# CASE py_inorder_typed_docstring expect=pass
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Iterable


async def in_order[T](
    items: Iterable[T],
    step: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]],
    *,
    reason: str,
) -> None:
    """Run each step one at a time; don't await anything else."""
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
